requested: 2026-10-22 ~18:40 by the researcher, after the Table 2 numbers had been seen
question: does the 20 s accuracy gap between the proposed temporal-CS system and mTRF / VLAAI come from the EEG context each system sees?  Restrict mTRF and VLAAI to the proposed system EEG span in training and scoring.

span.source: aln41/frozen.py cs anchors rint(linspace(0.4, 4.15, 16) * 128) and aln41/timebank.layout(128) crops
span.mapping: ext_common 64 Hz sample j = mean of 128 Hz samples 2j, 2j+1 -> [26, 608) at 128 Hz == [13, 304) at 64 Hz
span.not_restricted: cohort-level offline preprocessing and per-person standardisation (shared by every system incl. the proposed one)

mtrf_ctx.rule: envelope sample t used iff EEG t..t+32 all inside [13, 304); EEG outside the span set to NaN before the design matrix, finiteness asserted
mtrf_ctx.train: train people cs role=fit, attended envelope at t in [13, 271]
mtrf_ctx.alpha: same grid logspace(-3, 4, 8); mean per-segment Pearson r over t in [13, 271] on train people cs role=es
mtrf_ctx.refit: fit + es with the selected alpha
mtrf_ctx.margin: r(hat, att) - r(hat, ign) over t in [13, 271]

vlaai_ctx.rule: model input = EEG[:, 13:304] only (fully convolutional, zero padding at the window edges as natively); target / loss / validation r / margin over the same window (native VLAAI convention)
vlaai_ctx.dtu_input: common average reference, then per-listener per-channel z-score over span samples only
vlaai_ctx.fau_input: cache EEG span, Linear(31->64) adapter (spherical-spline init) trained jointly, as Table 2
vlaai_ctx.recipe: identical to Table 2 (seed 3401, Adam 1e-4, batch 64, <= 50 epochs, patience 5, best epoch by mean per-segment r on train people cs role=es, fp32 numerics); re-fitted per unit, not re-scored
vlaai_ctx.checks: finiteness, batch invariance, v2 swap check

clip_ctx.status: pre-declared, not implemented; added as a new module after the native CLIP row is complete
clip_ctx.ola: native Hann overlap-add, outer half-windows weight 1, normalised by summed weights, over [13, 304)
clip_ctx.rule: frozen stage-S encoder unchanged; stage-T readout (+ FAU adapter) re-fitted with the Table 2 recipe on windows inside the span; DTU re-reference / z-score over span samples; margin over [13, 304)

not_run.extend_proposed_to_full_5s: assessed only (needs new frozen GPU features); see report

excluded.mindmix: at chance in Table 2; left out by the researcher

unchanged.partition: ext_common / ALN4.1 public units (2 content folds x 5 person folds), same train / test people and roles
unchanged.integration: aln42.external_eval.integrate via ext_common.integrate_unit (5 / 10 / 20 s; 20 s primary)
unchanged.aggregation: ext_common.summarize: per person content folds averaged (both required); groups dtu nh/hi, fau th/ha/ci, all
